title: Reported Speech 1 – Zeit- & Ortsangaben
description: today → that day, here → there, ago → before

items.task: Ordne zu: direkte Rede → indirekte Rede.
Ordne zu: direkte Rede → indirekte Rede.
left: Mia said, “I’ll start my new job next week.”
Sam said, “I lived here last year.”
The twins said, “We met her two days ago.”
right: Ben said that he was busy that day.
Lena said that they would leave the next day.
Omar said that he had seen her the day before.
Mia said that she would start her new job the following week.
Sam said that he had lived there the year before.
The twins said that they had met her two days before.

items.text: She said that she would come ___.

items.prompt: “We saw them a week ago,” they said.
items.text: They said that they had seen them ___.
He said that he had gone there ___.

items.prompt: Ella said, “I’m going to the cinema this evening.”
items.text: Ella said that she was going to the cinema ___.
Tom said that he loved it ___.

items.prompt: “These shoes are too small,” Mia said.
items.text: Mia said that ___ shoes were too small.

items.prompt: “We moved here three years ago,” Mrs Green said.
items.text: Mrs Green said that they had moved ___ three years ___.

items.prompt: “I slept badly last night,” Leo said.
items.text: Leo said that he had slept badly ___.

items.prompt: “I’ll see you tomorrow,” Jo said to me.
items.text: Jo told me that she would see me ___.
Anna said that she had been ill ___.
They said that they were leaving ___.
Sam said that his cousin lived ___.

items.prompt: “I’ll start my course next month,” Lea said.
items.text: Lea said that she would start her course ___.

items.prompt: “We visited her two weeks ago,” they said.
items.text: They said that they had visited her ___.

items.answer: She said that she would arrive the next day.
He told me that they had met the day before.
The teacher said that the test would be the following week.
Tom said that he had bought those shoes the week before.

items.prompt: “I will finish the project tomorrow,” Nina said.
answers: Nina said (that) she would finish the project the next day.
Nina said (that) she would finish the project the following day.

items.prompt: “We bought this house two years ago,” Mr and Mrs Davis said.
answers: Mr and Mrs Davis said (that) they had bought that house two years before.

items.prompt: “I’m not feeling well today,” Ali said.
answers: Ali said (that) he was not feeling well that day.
